dogecoin.text: Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Ethereum...I can't keep up with all these crypto coins. Can we just stick to good old fashioned cash? 💸
Tech bros investing in memestocks like it's the next big thing. Sorry, but Dogecoin isn't going to make you a millionaire. 🤑
